pass_condition: Intervention, controls, falsifier, metrics, leakage, and statistics specified
protocol: K-Dense experimental-design and statistical-power; K-Dense statistical-analysis; ARS reporting standards
evidence: Intervention: one system-layer selector file (both interface-language keys and the direction key), executed at 106 task states. Controls: en baseline; stock cell for invisibility; A/A replicates; a placebo cell (seeded toolbar order); a tagged KeyID cell; planted controls in the application and synthetic plants; checker invariance on golds and do-nothing states. Falsifiers P1-P8 and kill criteria K0-K9, reachable. Simulation of the registered estimators (power-v4.py): sharp-null test corrected (0.048 at the null), census SMALL 0.97 at the null, PRESENT_HARM 0.86-0.96 at a 15% harm, MIRROR_SPECIFIC 0.023-0.027 under direction-free scenarios. Admission by intention to treat.
disclosed_limits: the placebo is a smaller rearrangement than mirroring (median displacement 264 px against 996 px)
MIRROR_SPECIFIC power 0.37-0.56 at a mirror-only 15% harm with n_pl = 2
the checker-invariance operationalization was chosen after the committed proxy's K0 result
